source.title: Midnight Inscription Guide — Azeroot specifically excluded from milling
source.author: Nurseos

quote: Azeroot – not milled, used directly for some recipe components.
notes: NEW cross-guide processing-eligibility contradiction, not a measured processing study. Overgear explicitly excludes Azeroot from milling; the current wow-professions Midnight inscription leveling guide lists exactly Tranquility Bloom, Argentleaf, Mana Lily and Sanguithorn as herbs to mill (Azeroot appears only as a direct crafting input). Icy Veins independently lists those same four herb-to-pigment milling families and separates Azeroot as a material purchase. This contrasts with preexisting research/v3/evidence/midnight/2026-10-30T1828-midnight-milling-ten-herbs.jsonl entry midnight-20261030-404, which inferred Azeroot was eligible from a generic 'any Midnight herb' description, without in-game proof. Both Azeroot item IDs 236774 and 236775 are independently listed as Azeroot on current TSM/BootyBayBroker pages. Those pages establish IDs but not an experimentally confirmed mill acceptance or actual rank IDs; exact input ranks intentionally remain unknown here. Master should source-check an actual current client Midnight Milling (spell 1269575) allowed-reagent filter; do not promote Azeroot to a valid Mill action or a no-mill exclusion until that check. No casts, yields, output IDs, hit counts, zeros or price facts are inferred. Original numeric searches for 272246 ilvl305 DE outputs, 237362 rank-specific Umbral Tin and 236761 milling full 0..N logs did not reveal a novel usable operation-level cohort; existing Cardinalai, JD3K, Honeybone, LuciferCastielSky, mutable Looter and prior restoration records were identified as existing and deliberately not reimported.
lookingFor: Azeroot 236774/236775 current Retail Midnight Milling eligibility versus generic any-herb rule; original current-build Midnight Disenchant/Prospect/Mill completed cast data for 272246, 237362 and 236761
